XMLDB.COMMENT: Metadata attached to core prior-learning evidence. Every table here extends a core entity by foreign key; none duplicates one. That is compensating measure MC-3 of DER-referentiel-001, and anti-pattern 2 of the scoping document.

TABLE.NAME: tool_vae_identity
TABLE.COMMENT: Correspondence between Moodle integer identifiers and opaque ULIDs. MC-8: without it the export cannot produce objects conforming to preuve.schema.json, which rejects integer keys outright.

FIELD.NAME: itemtype
FIELD.COMMENT: user, competency or structure

FIELD.NAME: itemid
FIELD.COMMENT: The Moodle identifier. Never used as a key in an exported object.

FIELD.NAME: uuid
FIELD.COMMENT: ULID, 26 characters of Crockford base 32.

INDEX.NAME: item
INDEX.COMMENT: One ULID per item. Also what makes the concurrent-mint recovery in identity_map correct.

TABLE.NAME: tool_vae_evidence
TABLE.COMMENT: Metadata core_competency does not carry: period of practice, setting, narrative, and the version of the certification record the claim refers to.

FIELD.NAME: uuid
FIELD.COMMENT: Identifier used in the exported dossier.

FIELD.NAME: userevidenceid
FIELD.COMMENT: Foreign key to competency_userevidence. The core record is an anchor: it carries a generated label and an empty description, never the narrative.

FIELD.NAME: candidateid
FIELD.COMMENT: The candidate this claim belongs to. NOT a duplicated core entity in the sense of the anti-pattern: it is this plugin's own owning relation to the user table, which every access check and every privacy query needs. Holding it means no query in the plugin has to name a core table, and it cannot drift - core offers no way to move evidence between users. A test asserts it matches the core record at creation.

FIELD.NAME: periodend
FIELD.COMMENT: periodend >= periodstart is enforced server side; no database can express it portably.

FIELD.NAME: settingtype
FIELD.COMMENT: Closed enumeration.

FIELD.NAME: settingdetail
FIELD.COMMENT: FREE TEXT. Covered by the anonymisation reminder, exactly like the narrative. Not a safe field.

FIELD.NAME: situation
FIELD.COMMENT: FREE TEXT. Describes what the professional did, never who it was done to.

FIELD.NAME: situationformat
FIELD.COMMENT: FORMAT_PLAIN or FORMAT_MARKDOWN only. HTML is excluded: this text is stored outside the core PARAM_CLEANHTML cleaning and rendered on the attestation screen.

FIELD.NAME: fichecode
FIELD.COMMENT: RNCP or RS record code.

FIELD.NAME: ficherang
FIELD.COMMENT: Rank within the record. Not null and not empty: combined with fichecode it forms the idnumber the import matches on, and an empty rank collides every rankless competency of the same record onto one another.

FIELD.NAME: ficheupdated
FIELD.COMMENT: Source update date AT THE TIME OF THE CLAIM. Without it a panel cannot establish which version of a framework a piece of evidence refers to.

FIELD.NAME: competencyid
FIELD.COMMENT: The competency this claim was made against, as the core numbers it. NOT a duplicated core entity: it is the only way this plugin can tell that the link it created has been replaced by another one. Without it the check degenerates into 'is there any link at all', and swapping C03 for C07 in tool_lp goes unreported while the dossier keeps naming C03 - measured, in adversarial review. Null on a row created before this field existed.

FIELD.NAME: corelabel
FIELD.COMMENT: The exact label this plugin wrote on the core evidence record when the claim was made. Kept so that the dossier can tell whether the anchor was renamed elsewhere - and kept as a STORED STRING rather than rebuilt on demand, because a rebuilt label depends on the timezone it is rebuilt in: a period starting on the first of a month falls in the previous one a few hours away, and the comparison would report a divergence that never happened. Measured, not supposed. 100 characters, the length of the core column. Null on a row created before this field existed: the plugin then reports nothing rather than guessing.

TABLE.NAME: tool_vae_attest
TABLE.COMMENT: A manager's attestation. Held here rather than on the core record so that withdrawing it never destroys the candidate's evidence.

FIELD.NAME: attestantid
FIELD.COMMENT: Nullable. Set to null on erasure, together with the three fields below.

FIELD.NAME: attestantrole
FIELD.COMMENT: Nulled on erasure with attestantid. In practice this names an establishment and a job title, which identifies the person as surely as their user id.

FIELD.NAME: statement
FIELD.COMMENT: Nulled on erasure with attestantid. In practice begins 'I, the undersigned...' and names the person in full.

FIELD.NAME: attestedat
FIELD.COMMENT: Nulled on erasure: a date of signature attached to a named role is still a trace of the signatory.

FIELD.NAME: withdrawnreason
FIELD.COMMENT: rgpd, erreur or contestation

FIELD.NAME: withdrawreqby
FIELD.COMMENT: The manager who asked the signatory to withdraw this attestation. Set while the request is open, cleared when the signatory accepts (withdrawal) or refuses. Never kept as history.

FIELD.NAME: withdrawreqat
FIELD.COMMENT: When the request was made. Null: no request is open.

FIELD.NAME: attestantuuid
FIELD.COMMENT: The signatory of an attestation carried in from an archive, by the ULID the archive gives: they hold no account here, so attestantid is null. Nulled on withdrawal and erasure with the four fields above.

FIELD.NAME: importedat
FIELD.COMMENT: When this attestation was carried in from an archive. Null for one given on this site. Only a site administrator withdraws an imported attestation.

FIELD.NAME: piecesread
FIELD.COMMENT: T-13: 1 when the signatory ticked that they took note of the supporting pieces of the declaration, null when there were none or the signature was erased. A DECLARATION, not a fact: the plugin cannot know that a file was read.

TABLE.NAME: tool_vae_source
TABLE.COMMENT: Provenance of an imported certification record. licence and attribution are not decorative: Licence Ouverte 2.0 requires both attribution and the source update date wherever the framework is shown.

FIELD.NAME: fichetype
FIELD.COMMENT: rncp or rs

FIELD.NAME: successorcode
FIELD.COMMENT: The code of the imported record that replaces this one (T-30, D-14), declared by an administrator. Null: none declared. A declaration, not an action: nothing is moved because of it.

FIELD.NAME: lastimport
FIELD.COMMENT: Written on every attempt, successful or not.

FIELD.NAME: lastimportstatus
FIELD.COMMENT: ok, error, or deleted (the framework was deleted in the core). Without it a failed import that leaves an old date reads as a successful one.

TABLE.NAME: tool_vae_obsolete
TABLE.COMMENT: A competency that has left the source, or that tool_lp has altered locally. Core carries neither an obsolete nor a visible flag on a competency, hence this table. Nothing is ever deleted in cascade: orphaned evidence is still evidence.

FIELD.NAME: kind
FIELD.COMMENT: missing, renamed or moved. The last two record a local divergence introduced through tool_lp, which the plugin can detect on re-import but cannot prevent.

TABLE.NAME: tool_vae_passage
TABLE.COMMENT: Mapping from a competency of a superseded certification record to its successor. Never populated automatically: carrying evidence across records is a human decision, named and dated.

TABLE.NAME: tool_vae_ref
TABLE.COMMENT: An address an administrator gives for a certification record, where the certifier publishes its rule of validation (T-41). An address and a short title, never the text of a rule, and nothing about a person.

FIELD.NAME: title
FIELD.COMMENT: Short title chosen by the administrator, shown as the text of the link.

FIELD.NAME: url
FIELD.COMMENT: http or https only (piece_manager::validate_url).

FIELD.NAME: checkedat
FIELD.COMMENT: The day the administrator checked that the page says what the title promises. Null: not said.

TABLE.NAME: tool_vae_scope
TABLE.COMMENT: A competency a candidate says is outside their activity (T-42). Declarative and without effect: not an attestation, not an exemption, nothing is counted or reminded because of it. Removed when the candidate takes it back.

FIELD.NAME: uuid
FIELD.COMMENT: Identifier for the export.

FIELD.NAME: candidateid
FIELD.COMMENT: The candidate. The only author.

FIELD.NAME: fichecode
FIELD.COMMENT: The record, as on a declaration, so that the mark survives a competency removed from the core.

FIELD.NAME: ficherang
FIELD.COMMENT: The rank of the competency or the bloc in the record.

FIELD.NAME: note
FIELD.COMMENT: An optional sentence from the candidate, under the reminder of anonymisation.

TABLE.NAME: tool_vae_aicall
TABLE.COMMENT: A call a candidate made to the reformulation aid (T-70): who and when, never the text sent nor the answer. It exists to hold the limits (a pause between two calls, a ceiling per day), which the core cannot: its limiter is a fixed hour kept in a cache. Purged within three days at the latest.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The candidate who asked.

TABLE.NAME: tool_vae_referent
TABLE.COMMENT: Who is the referent of a bloc of a certification record (T-23): a rule of the site, not of a candidate. It only decides which of the managers who follow a candidate is told first of a declaration. It gives and takes away no right: whoever follows a candidate may still read and attest.

FIELD.NAME: fichecode
FIELD.COMMENT: The record, as on a declaration.

FIELD.NAME: ficherang
FIELD.COMMENT: The rank of the bloc; empty for the whole record.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The referent, a member of the staff.

FIELD.NAME: createdby
FIELD.COMMENT: The administrator who named the referent. Set to 0 when that person is erased.

TABLE.NAME: tool_vae_archive
TABLE.COMMENT: Register of the archives this platform issued, export and backup alike: what lets it confirm that an archive is the one it produced. The SHA-256 digests in the manifest only detect damage - whoever changes a file can rewrite its digest - so the manifest itself is vouched for here, outside the archive. A row is not the archive (MC-9): it holds no claim, only a digest.

FIELD.NAME: archiveuuid
FIELD.COMMENT: The archive's ULID, the archive field of its manifest. A forger who changes it turns the archive into one this platform never issued: it is then reimported with a warning, never as verified.

FIELD.NAME: sha256
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 of the exact bytes of manifeste.json as written into the archive. The manifest lists the digest of every other file, so this one digest covers the whole archive.

FIELD.NAME: candidateuuid
FIELD.COMMENT: The candidate's ULID, as the archive names them. Not their user id: the row describes the archive, and once the candidate's identity map entry is gone the ULID points at nobody. Erasing the candidate, or deleting their account, deletes their rows.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Who produced the archive. Set to 0 when that person is erased: the archive stays issued, the person leaves the row.

TABLE.NAME: tool_vae_draft
TABLE.COMMENT: One section of a document a candidate writes, with the draft in progress (T-81). A document is a doctype for a candidate; a section is a part of it that has its own history; a repeatable section has a slot. The working text is the autosaved draft and is NOT a version: a version is only written when the candidate asks. Free text, covered by the anonymisation reminder wherever it can describe a person receiving care.

FIELD.NAME: uuid
FIELD.COMMENT: Identifier for the export.

FIELD.NAME: candidateid
FIELD.COMMENT: The candidate the section belongs to.

FIELD.NAME: doctype
FIELD.COMMENT: Closed enumeration: faisabilite and validation (T-11).

FIELD.NAME: section
FIELD.COMMENT: Code of the section within the document.

FIELD.NAME: slot
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 for a single section, 1..n for a repeated one.

FIELD.NAME: fichecode
FIELD.COMMENT: The certification record the section depends on, EMPTY STRING when it does not (the dossier de faisabilite). Part of the address of a section (T-11): two records have the same section codes. No default: the core drops an empty default of a char column, so every insert writes it.

FIELD.NAME: working
FIELD.COMMENT: The draft in progress. Null when nothing is in progress.

FIELD.NAME: workingat
FIELD.COMMENT: When the working text was last autosaved.

FIELD.NAME: currentversion
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of the latest version, 0 when there is none.

TABLE.NAME: tool_vae_version
TABLE.COMMENT: A snapshot of a section, written when the candidate asks and never changed afterwards (T-81). A restoration is a new row. The content is a full snapshot, not a delta: a lost row damages no other.

FIELD.NAME: draftid
FIELD.COMMENT: The section.

FIELD.NAME: number
FIELD.COMMENT: 1, 2, 3 per section.

FIELD.NAME: content
FIELD.COMMENT: FREE TEXT, or JSON for a section made of fields.

FIELD.NAME: contenthash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 of the content: no two identical versions in a row, and integrity.

FIELD.NAME: authorid
FIELD.COMMENT: Who saved it. Nulled on that person's erasure.

FIELD.NAME: note
FIELD.COMMENT: An optional sentence from the candidate.

FIELD.NAME: restoredfrom
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of the version this one restores, when it does.

TABLE.NAME: tool_vae_deposit
TABLE.COMMENT: A deposit of the dossier de faisabilite (T-21): a dated, hashed snapshot of the latest saved version of every section, never changed afterwards. Not a lock: the candidate goes on writing, and a new deposit is a new row with the next number.

FIELD.NAME: uuid
FIELD.COMMENT: Identifier for the export.

FIELD.NAME: candidateid
FIELD.COMMENT: The candidate who deposited. The only author.

FIELD.NAME: doctype
FIELD.COMMENT: The document deposited; faisabilite for now.

FIELD.NAME: number
FIELD.COMMENT: 1, 2, 3 per candidate and document.

FIELD.NAME: content
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON snapshot: code, place, version, date and text or values of every section saved. May hold identity and status: read only behind tool/vae:identityview.

FIELD.NAME: contenthash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 of the snapshot.

FIELD.NAME: note
FIELD.COMMENT: An optional sentence from the candidate.

TABLE.NAME: tool_vae_opinion
TABLE.COMMENT: The opinion of a manager who follows a candidate, on one deposit (T-10, lot 5b, D-12). Free text, dated and hashed, never changed afterwards. Attached to the deposit it was written on: a later deposit has no opinion until one is written on it.

FIELD.NAME: uuid
FIELD.COMMENT: Identifier for the export.

FIELD.NAME: depositid
FIELD.COMMENT: The deposit the opinion is about.

FIELD.NAME: authorid
FIELD.COMMENT: The manager who wrote it. Nulled on that person's erasure.

FIELD.NAME: content
FIELD.COMMENT: FREE TEXT. Never a verdict the plugin computes.

FIELD.NAME: contenthash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 of the content.

TABLE.NAME: tool_vae_request
TABLE.COMMENT: A request for precision a manager who follows a candidate makes on one declaration before attesting it (T-20, D-13), and the candidate's answer. Free text, dated and hashed, never changed afterwards: the question once, the answer once. Not a verdict, not a gate: attesting does not depend on it.

FIELD.NAME: uuid
FIELD.COMMENT: Identifier for the export.

FIELD.NAME: evidenceid
FIELD.COMMENT: The declaration the question is about.

FIELD.NAME: authorid
FIELD.COMMENT: The manager who asked. Nulled on that person's erasure.

FIELD.NAME: question
FIELD.COMMENT: FREE TEXT. A question in words, never a judgement the plugin computes.

FIELD.NAME: questionhash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 of the question.

FIELD.NAME: answer
FIELD.COMMENT: FREE TEXT, written once by the candidate. Null while unanswered. Covered by the anonymisation reminder.

FIELD.NAME: answerhash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 of the answer.

TABLE.NAME: tool_vae_carry
TABLE.COMMENT: A declaration the candidate carried over to the record that replaces its own (T-30, lot 3, D-14). One row per carry: the old declaration stays where it was, with its attestation; the new one is an ordinary declaration, to be attested again. The decision of the administrator is copied here, because the row of tool_vae_passage can be replaced or taken back afterwards and the trace must stay.

FIELD.NAME: oldevidenceid
FIELD.COMMENT: The declaration on the replaced record. Unique: one carry per declaration.

FIELD.NAME: newevidenceid
FIELD.COMMENT: The declaration made on the replacing record.

FIELD.NAME: fromcompetencyid
FIELD.COMMENT: The competency of the replaced record, as decided.

FIELD.NAME: tocompetencyid
FIELD.COMMENT: The competency of the replacing record, as decided.

FIELD.NAME: decidedby
FIELD.COMMENT: The administrator who decided the correspondence. Zero once that account is erased.

FIELD.NAME: decidedat
FIELD.COMMENT: When the correspondence was decided. Zero once the decider is erased.

FIELD.NAME: note
FIELD.COMMENT: FREE TEXT, the administrator's note on the correspondence. Emptied with the decider.

FIELD.NAME: carriedat
FIELD.COMMENT: When the candidate carried the declaration over.

TABLE.NAME: tool_vae_piece
TABLE.COMMENT: A supporting piece a candidate attached to one declaration (T-13, D-3): a file kept in the plugin's own file area, or a link. Never changed, except by its removal, which erases the file, the title and the address and keeps the rest. The original name of a file is NEVER kept: it is a free field the reminder does not cover. A piece the plugin cannot read for names: anonymisation is the candidate's, the reading is the manager's, and the archive says so (DER-referentiel-001, amendment 4).

FIELD.NAME: uuid
FIELD.COMMENT: Identifier used in the exported dossier (MC-8), and the name the file is stored, served and archived under.

FIELD.NAME: evidenceid
FIELD.COMMENT: The declaration the piece supports.

FIELD.NAME: candidateid
FIELD.COMMENT: The candidate, as on the declaration. Kept here so that the privacy index and the file area lead to the person without a join.

FIELD.NAME: kind
FIELD.COMMENT: file or link. Closed enumeration.

FIELD.NAME: nature
FIELD.COMMENT: What the piece is, from a closed list (piece_manager::NATURES): the first answer to the risk that a file names a person.

FIELD.NAME: title
FIELD.COMMENT: FREE TEXT, optional. Covered by the anonymisation reminder. Emptied when the piece is removed.

FIELD.NAME: ext
FIELD.COMMENT: File only. The extension of the DETECTED type, never that of the name supplied.

FIELD.NAME: mimetype
FIELD.COMMENT: File only. Detected on the content.

FIELD.NAME: filesize
FIELD.COMMENT: File only, in bytes.

FIELD.NAME: sha256
FIELD.COMMENT: File only. Computed on reception and checked against the stored file; kept when the piece is removed. A link has none: what is at an address can change.

FIELD.NAME: url
FIELD.COMMENT: Link only. FREE TEXT in practice (a path can carry a name): covered by the reminder. Emptied when the piece is removed.

FIELD.NAME: timeremoved
FIELD.COMMENT: Null while the piece is there.

TABLE.NAME: tool_vae_attest_piece
TABLE.COMMENT: The supporting pieces an attestation covered (T-13, lot 2): the list the signatory was shown and signed, with the digest each file had. What lets the dossier say that a piece was added after the signature, and which signature. Emptied when the signature is erased or withdrawn: it is part of what the signature said.

FIELD.NAME: attestid
FIELD.COMMENT: The attestation.

FIELD.NAME: pieceid
FIELD.COMMENT: The piece.

FIELD.NAME: sha256
FIELD.COMMENT: The digest of the file when it was signed; null for a link, which has none.

TABLE.NAME: tool_vae_piece_open
TABLE.COMMENT: Who opened a supporting piece, and when (T-13, lot 2): the fact the attestation screen can show ("2 pieces of 3 not opened"). Opening is not reading, and the plugin says so. One row per person and piece; the time is that of the last opening. Erased with the person.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Who opened it.
